---
name: '🧹 Refactor / Tech Debt'
about: 'Propose code cleanup, optimization, or technical debt management'
title: 'refactor: <short description>'
labels: ['refactor']
assignees: []
---

## 📝 Description

Describe the current state and why it needs refactoring or cleanup.

## 🛠 Proposed Changes

- [ ] Component reorganization
- [ ] Code pruning (unused variables/keys)
- [ ] Optimization (performance/bundle size)
- [ ] Documentation updates

## 🛠 To-Do List (Tasks)

- [ ] Audit affected files
- [ ] Implement refactoring
- [ ] Run `npm run lint` and fix any issues
- [ ] Verify no regressions in core functionality

## ✅ Definition of Done (DoD)

- [ ] Code is cleaner and more maintainable.
- [ ] Build passes without warnings or errors.
- [ ] Tests (if any) pass.
